title: Oathbreaker
problem: It adds a second copy of the realm-boost stat amount. Where there are no realm-boost stats (outside normal realm battles) there is nothing to double, so it does nothing there. The Rodian Aftermath damage effect that Oathbreaker also carries is a separate, already-registered bug.
notes: Text: Your creatures gain 100% more benefit from stat-increasing Realm Boosts. This trait does not stack. Evidence: crit_attack: base scr_RealmBoostCount @0x1417b1dd7; Oathbreaker scr_AnyAllyHasPassive(1797) @0x1417b1e83 -> scr_RealmBoostCount @0x1417b1f3a; start-of-battle @0x14174bd1a / @0x14174bf01. Rodian Aftermath part: SU-0078 (public). Reasoning: '100% more benefit from Realm Boosts' with no Realm Boosts is zero, so the text holds. The other Oathbreaker issue is already covered by SU-0078 and is outside this row. App note (unpatched game): Oathbreaker only does something where Realm Boosts give stats; in other battles there is nothing to double. Source: errata round 2 (2026-10-26).
